tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently attended a photography workshop and found it very informative and enjoyable. You want to reach out to the instructor, Mr. Carter, to ask for additional tips on portrait photography, which you are particularly interested in. You also want to express your gratitude for the workshop. Write an email to Mr. Carter.
bullets: Mention what you found valuable about the workshop.
Ask for additional tips on portrait photography.
Express your gratitude for his guidance and insights.
tasks.subject: Request for Additional Tips on Portrait Photography
